{{Top|leg}}
'''Cityspeeders''' were narrow, two-person [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] designed to navigate through constrained urban environments. The [[Lant Mining Corporation]] executives who lived and worked on the [[city platform]]s on [[Lish V]] used cityspeeders for private transport.
